item.title: CVE-2026-87902 — WordPress Core
item.description: Threat Signal 66. WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.
